args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications and first aid kit
- Travel insurance information

Beach & Water Activities:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses
- Beach hat or cap
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy walking shoes
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Light rain jacket
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Insect repellent
- Sun hat

Casual Wear:
- T-shirts/tank tops
- Shorts
- Lightweight pants/skirts
- Sundresses
- Light sweater or jacket for cooler evenings
- Undergarments
- Sleepwear
- Workout clothes

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if needed)
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Memory cards for camera

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for reading
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable water bottle
- Small umbrella
- Laundry bag

Special Activity Items:
- Formal outfit for luau (June 16)
- Comfortable walking shoes for Pearl Harbor visit (June 14)
- Spa attire for relaxation day (June 17)

Notes:
- Weather in Hawaii in June is typically warm (75-88°F) with occasional rain showers
- Pack light, breathable clothing
- Most hotels provide basic toiletries, but bring your preferred brands
- Consider laundry options if staying for 10+ days
